acceptance: Nested custom combo, grid virtualization and modal-form samples work without source-specific CSS selectors; composites are derived structures that raise no effect claim.

positive.fixture: composite recognition for tabs, disclosure, menu, dialog, combobox popup, tree, pagination, bulk selection, sortable columns, filter bar, file input, date picker, editable cell and scroll-probe virtual list; choose through a custom popup in a real browser

negative.fixture: navigation chrome, mixed blocks and link menus are not collections; a link that says it deletes is never downgraded; script links stay unknown; ambiguous members fall back
negative.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-recognizer --test composites --test rules_v3

versions.schema: recognition document gains composites, editable, shown, structural only under --rules 3; observer states gain href kind

security_and_source_permissions: Hints stay candidates; no write is promoted to an executable contract; the scroll probe reads and restores scroll position only.
performance_memory_storage: Recognizer p50 about 45 ms, max about 80 ms and about 11 MB RSS on 58 pages, unchanged from T02.
known_limitations: 98 composites on development and validation pages are unannotated (mostly hidden dialogs and menus of site chrome)
Popups built on demand from unlabeled elements, drag and drop and Choices.js duplicated inputs stay unrecognized
Names agree for fewer than half of recognized composites
